info.title: VegaDuta event API
info.description: Event surfaces of the VegaDuta platform: Server-Sent Event streams, outbound webhooks and the voice relay WebSocket. Generated from docs/api/openapi.json and contracts/ by scripts/docs/asyncapi.mjs; do not edit by hand.

host.description: Host (and port) of your VegaDuta API.

AgentController_chat.title: Chat
AgentController_chat.description: POST /api/agents/{agentId}/chat answered as text/event-stream. Run one chat turn and stream the reply as Server-Sent Events: each event's data is the next text chunk. Send the same sessionId to continue a conversation; the server keeps the memory. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

ChatBranchController_edit.title: Edit
ChatBranchController_edit.description: POST /api/agents/{agentId}/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageId}/edit answered as text/event-stream. Replace the text of an earlier user message on a new branch and stream the new reply; the original branch is kept. Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404. Requires the APP_CHAT_BRANCHING_ENABLED feature flag (app.chat.branching.enabled); when it is off this route answers 404. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

ChatBranchController_regenerate.title: Regenerate
ChatBranchController_regenerate.description: POST /api/agents/{agentId}/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageId}/regenerate answered as text/event-stream. Produce another answer to the same user message and stream it; the previous answer is kept as a sibling. Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404. Requires the APP_CHAT_BRANCHING_ENABLED feature flag (app.chat.branching.enabled); when it is off this route answers 404. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

DemoStudioController_mission.description: POST /api/demo/studio/agents/{agentId}/mission answered as text/event-stream. Public route: no bearer token is required at the gateway. Webhook, device and pairing endpoints verify their own credential (signature, device token or code) inside the handler. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

WorkflowController_runEvents.title: Run events
WorkflowController_runEvents.description: GET /api/workflows/{workflowId}/runs/{runId}/events answered as text/event-stream. Live run progress as Server-Sent Events named snapshot, run.*, node.* and error; each data is {seq, type, nodeId, ts, data}. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to resume after the last seq seen. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

agentStep_approval_required.title: approval_required
agentStep_approval_required.summary: A tool call was recorded as a pending approval and the turn is waiting for a person. Sent after the call's tool_result.
agentStep_approval_required.description: Sent in-band on a stream whose request set stepEvents=true: the SSE data is @@AGENT_STEP_EVENT_4d81ba@@ immediately followed by this JSON on one line. A stream that did not ask never carries it.

tool.description: The tool whose call is held.

approvalId.description: The pending approval request, as listed by the approvals API.

agentStep_continuation.name: continuation
agentStep_continuation.title: continuation
agentStep_continuation.summary: Another model pass is carrying the reply on.
agentStep_continuation.description: Sent in-band on a stream whose request set stepEvents=true: the SSE data is @@AGENT_STEP_EVENT_4d81ba@@ immediately followed by this JSON on one line. A stream that did not ask never carries it.

pass.description: The pass that is starting; 1 is the first continuation.

maxPasses.description: How many passes of this kind the platform will make.

reason.description: Why: the reply hit the output limit, the reply stopped at a step it announced but did not take, or the platform is carrying the task on after a person decided a held tool call.

agentStep_failover.name: failover
agentStep_failover.title: failover
agentStep_failover.summary: The turn moved to another model after the one before it failed (the agent's fallback provider, or the next rung of the platform-hosted pool).
agentStep_failover.description: Sent in-band on a stream whose request set stepEvents=true: the SSE data is @@AGENT_STEP_EVENT_4d81ba@@ immediately followed by this JSON on one line. A stream that did not ask never carries it.

toModel.description: The model the turn moved to. Absent when it is not known by name.

reason.description: Why the turn moved; the same codes as retry.

agentStep_finish.name: finish
agentStep_finish.title: finish
agentStep_finish.summary: The reply ended. Sent once per reply, before run_finished. A client offers Continue on length or interrupted and shows its refusal notice on safety, instead of matching the notice text appended to the reply.
agentStep_finish.description: Sent in-band on a stream whose request set stepEvents=true: the SSE data is @@AGENT_STEP_EVENT_4d81ba@@ immediately followed by this JSON on one line. A stream that did not ask never carries it.

finishReason.description: How the reply ended: an answer, cut off at the output limit, stopped by the provider's safety system, an unusable tool call, empty, or broken off after some text.

detail.description: The provider's own word for a refusal (for example content_filter). Optional.

agentStep_retry.name: retry
agentStep_retry.title: retry
agentStep_retry.summary: The same model is being called again after a failure before its first token, or the reply is asked for again after an unusable tool call.
agentStep_retry.description: Sent in-band on a stream whose request set stepEvents=true: the SSE data is @@AGENT_STEP_EVENT_4d81ba@@ immediately followed by this JSON on one line. A stream that did not ask never carries it.

attempt.description: The try about to run; 1 is the first.

maxAttempts.description: How many tries the platform will make in all.

reason.description: A short code: rate_limited, timeout, provider_unavailable, auth_failed, billing, model_not_found, provider_error or malformed_tool_call. A client may show an unknown code with its underscores read as spaces.

payload.title: Twilio Conversation Relay - dtmf message
payload.description: Source: VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handleDtmf, read directly (2026-07-19). Master Roadmap 2026 item #17 fast-follow. A digit with no VoiceDtmfMappingService match is a silent no-op by design (ifPresent, no else branch) - not an error. B4 (voice-safety) owns DTMF ACTIONS; this handler and this schema only cover parsing/menu-routing, not action dispatch.

digit.description: A blank digit is a no-op (handler returns early if digit.isBlank()). Real Twilio DTMF digits are single characters (0-9, *, #) but the handler does not itself constrain length/charset beyond blank-check, so this schema doesn't either - it schemas what the handler enforces, not what Twilio's docs say it will send.

payload.title: Twilio Conversation Relay - error message
payload.description: Source: VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handleTextMessage, read directly (2026-07-19). case "error" -> log.warn(..., node.path("description").asText("")) - logged only, no state transition, no reply sent. Included for corpus completeness (the replay test asserts this doesn't throw), not because the handler does anything interesting with it.

description.description: Free text. Missing/blank defaults to empty string via asText("") - not a failure mode.

payload.title: Twilio Conversation Relay - interrupt message
payload.description: Source: VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handleTextMessage, read directly (2026-07-19). case "interrupt" -> disposeActive(session) reads zero fields off the message node - there is nothing beyond 'type' to validate. Kept as its own schema file (rather than folded into the README) purely so the fixture corpus has one schema per handled message type, matching the directory's own convention.

payload.title: Twilio Conversation Relay - prompt message
payload.description: Source: VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handlePrompt, read directly (2026-07-19). The handler only acts when last=true AND voicePrompt is non-blank (node.path('last').asBoolean(false), node.path('voicePrompt').asText('')) - a partial/interim transcript (last=false) is a documented no-op, not an error, so this schema treats last=false as equally valid, just inert.

last.description: Only last=true triggers AgentChatService#chat. last=false (interim transcript) is silently ignored by design - not a failure mode.

voicePrompt.description: The caller's utterance. A blank string with last=true is also a silent no-op (handler returns early) - not an error.

payload.title: Twilio Conversation Relay - setup message
payload.description: Source: core/omnichannel/.../twilio/VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handleSetup, read directly (2026-07-19). Only the three fields the handler actually calls node.path(...) on are required here; Twilio's real 'setup' message carries more fields (e.g. direction, customParameters) that this handler never reads and this schema does not constrain.

accountSid.description: Resolved via TenantResolutionService.resolveTenantSchema(TWILIO, accountSid); falls back to the DEFAULT_SCHEMA if unresolved, so an empty/unknown value does not itself fail setup - it degrades to the default tenant.

callSid.description: Stored in session attributes and used only for logging/correlation - never parsed for structure.

from.description: The caller's phone number - used as ChannelSessionService.resolveOrCreate's externalId (VOICE channel), same pairing-gate semantics as every other channel.

webhook_workflowEvent.name: workflowEvent
webhook_workflowEvent.summary: Platform event delivered to a webhook subscription
webhook_workflowEvent.description: POSTed to each enabled subscription whose event filter matches. The body is the WorkflowEvent envelope; payload is event-type specific. The test delivery (webhook.test) carries only eventType, tenantId, timestamp and payload. Documented event types: channel.whatsapp.message.received: Inbound WhatsApp message reached the platform. channel.sms.message.received: Inbound SMS reached the platform. channel.messenger.message.received: Inbound Facebook Messenger message. channel.instagram.message.received: Inbound Instagram DM. channel.slack.message.received: Inbound Slack message. channel.discord.message.received: Inbound Discord message. channel.x.message.received: Inbound X (Twitter) DM. channel.telegram.message.received: Inbound Telegram message. channel.email.message.received: Inbound email. channel.teams.message.received: Inbound Microsoft Teams message. workflow.run.started: A workflow run began executing. workflow.run.completed: A workflow run finished successfully. workflow.run.failed: A workflow run failed. workflow.run.cancelled: A workflow run was cancelled. workflow.run.resumed: A paused workflow run resumed. workflow.node.completed: A single workflow node finished (carries nodeId). workflow.output.emitted: A workflow's OUTPUT node produced a result. approval.requested: An action entered the human-approval queue. approval.resolved: An approval request was approved or rejected. approval.execution.recorded: An approved action's execution reached a terminal state. document.generation.completed: A document-generation job finished (COMPLETE or FAILED). agent.message.completed: An agent finished and persisted a reply (payload: agentId, sessionId, answerChars, answerExcerpt, source). webhook.test: Synthetic event sent by the Test button / POST .../test.

X-VegaDuta-Event.description: The event type of this delivery.

X-VegaDuta-Delivery.description: Delivery id, stable across retries of the same delivery. Deliveries are at-least-once: store it and ignore a repeat.

X-VegaDuta-Signature.description: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the subscription secret (whsec_...)>. Recompute it over the raw bytes, compare in constant time, and reject a t older than a few minutes to stop replays.
